output.title: Cloudflare DNS01 fix: issuer solver configuration not visible in inputs
output.content: This fix only matters for certificates issued through DNS01 challenges on Cloudflare (ev-b8d6f16e3c8c). The environment does use cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate manifests. However, the inputs include no Issuer or ClusterIssuer manifests, and the only CRD listed is certificates.cert-manager.io, so there is nothing showing whether any issuer uses a Cloudflare DNS01 solver. To settle this, check whether the issuers your Certificates reference use a Cloudflare DNS01 solver; if they do, this fix is relevant to you.
